PLATFORM:

- Android mobile devices.
- Landscape orientation only.
- Full-screen gameplay.
- Touchscreen controls.
- Responsive mobile interface.
- Optimized for mid-range Android phones.
- Target stable 60 FPS, with adjustable graphics settings.

GRAPHICS:

- Fully 3D first-person perspective.
- Dark futuristic underground military research facility.
- Detailed laboratories, corridors, security rooms and bunkers.
- Realistic lighting, shadows and atmospheric effects.
- High-quality 3D weapon models.
- Sci-fi military visual style.
- Adjustable low, medium and high graphics settings.

MOBILE CONTROLS:
Create a professional mobile FPS control layout:

- Left virtual joystick for movement.
- Right side touch area for camera rotation and aiming.
- Large fire button on the right.
- Dedicated aim-down-sights button.
- Reload button.
- Jump button.
- Crouch button.
- Sprint button.
- Weapon switching buttons.
- Adjustable joystick sensitivity.
- Adjustable camera sensitivity.
- Allow players to customize button positions and sizes.

GAMEPLAY:

- Smooth first-person movement.
- Responsive touch aiming.
- Realistic weapon animations.
- Three usable weapons: pistol, assault rifle and shotgun.
- Weapon switching and reloading.
- Ammunition and health systems.
- Enemy AI with patrol and detection behavior.
- Interactive doors and objects.
- Health and ammunition pickups.
- Three playable mission areas.
- Checkpoints and mission objectives.

ENEMIES:
Create hostile futuristic security robots.
They should patrol the facility, detect the player, move toward the player and engage in combat.

MOBILE HUD:

- Health bar in bottom left.
- Ammunition counter in bottom right.
- Weapon icon.
- Mission objective at the top.
- Minimalist military interface.
- Clear and readable buttons.

MENUS:

- Animated main menu.
- Play.
- Settings.
- Graphics settings.
- Audio settings.
- Sensitivity settings.
- Control customization.
- Pause menu.
- Victory and game-over screens.

PERFORMANCE:

- Optimize 3D models and textures for Android.
- Use efficient lighting and shadows.
- Include graphics quality options.
- Avoid excessive particle effects.
- Maintain responsive touchscreen input.
- Prevent memory-heavy unnecessary effects.

IMPORTANT:
This must be a genuine playable 3D mobile FPS game, not a 2D game, not a mockup and not a desktop game with mobile buttons added afterward.

All touchscreen controls must work correctly. The player must be able to move, aim, shoot, reload, switch weapons and complete missions entirely using the smartphone touchscreen.

Use Turkish for all menus and interface text.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
